_about: SEO round 1 (6 Nov 2026): the citation layer of the four studies that have a Zenodo DOI. One entry per study; the build reads it for the 'Cite this study' box, the Highwire citation_doi and citation_public_url meta, the ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD and /llms.txt. DOIs and titles were read from the Zenodo API (zenodo.org/api/records/<id>) on 6 Nov 2026; doi.org answers 302 to zenodo.org for each. title is the page H1 without its full stop, the Zenodo record title and citation_title: tests/test_seo1.py holds them equal.
